release_name: Live TV v4.2.0 — Premium Broadcast Edition: Zero-Ad Shield, AI Video Clarity HDR, Peek Preview & Xtream IPTV
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🛡️ 100% Zero-Ad & Anti-Popup Shield: Enforced WebKit security delegate and inline ad filters unconditionally blocking popups, new window traps, redirect domains, and intrusive overlay banners across macOS and mobile remote

✨ AI Video Clarity & Retina HDR Enhancer: Hardware-accelerated post-processing filters featuring Normal, AI Sharp 4K, HDR Cinema, and Sports Vivid with dedicated toolbar cycling and real-time HUD badge feedback
👀 Live Channel Peek Preview (Hover Sniffer): Instant floating picture-in-picture preview bubble when hovering over channel cards for >500ms before tuning
🧭 In-Player Quick Mini-Guide: Frosted glass bottom drawer (ArrowDown or Guide button) allowing rapid one-click channel surfing without leaving playback
🔇 Smart Commercial Break Muter: 1-click commercial break mute timer cycling 45s, 60s, 90s, 120s with real-time countdown badge and automatic audio restoration
📡 Xtream Codes IPTV API & Multi-Playlist Vault: Native support for Xtream IPTV server logins (/player_api.php), auto-ingesting live stream categories directly into your library
📶 Metered Data Saver Mode: Smart bandwidth conservation mode restricting playback to 720p/480p and pausing background hover video previews
🎙️ Alternative Live Commentary Sync: Auxiliary live audio stream playback with precision delay sync (±0.5s) for custom radio or language broadcasts
🎨 Brand-New Modern Glass Dock Icon & Fixed Back Button: High-res glassmorphic app icon with immediate Dock cache refresh, and persistent non-collapsing Back button
